ERP database design

A synthetic ERP database modelled on the field names of the student login and extended to the teacher and administrative scopes. All data is generated; nothing comes from a real ERP. Built by build_erp.py from erp_schema.dsl.

10schemas
87tables
549columns
130foreign keys
27sensitive columns

1. Schemas at a glance

SchemaPurposeTables
auth AuthenticationLogins, roles, sessions, OTPs, login audit6: account, role, account_role, session, otp, login_audit
org OrganisationDepartments, programs, halls, academic sessions5: department, program, hall, hall_room, academic_session

acad AcademicsCurriculum, registration, results, attendance, exams, applications, records27: curriculum, course, curriculum_course, course_offering, offering_instructor, timetable_slot, registration, registration_card, result, semester_performance, assignment_mark, class_attendance, exam_schedule, exam_attendance, admit_card, special_program_application, program_switch_application, breadth_choice, convocation_registration, graduation_clearance, award_prize, student_activity, course_feedback, medical_leave, student_document, rep_nomination, data_sharing_consent
fin FinanceFees, payments, scholarships, mediclaim, salary10: fee_head, fee_structure, fee_demand, fee_demand_item, payment, family_income_declaration, scholarship_scheme, scholarship_award, mediclaim_claim, salary_slip

5. Authentication design (all in PostgreSQL)

  • Passwords: pgcrypto crypt(pw, gen_salt('bf', 12)) in auth.account.password_hash. Separate hashes for the passphrase and the campus-net password, as the login page has them.
  • Login: auth.login(login_id, password, ip, user_agent) returns a session token (random 32 bytes; only its SHA-256 is stored in auth.session). Wrong user and wrong password give the same error.
  • Lockout: 5 failures set locked_until to 15 minutes ahead; success resets the counter. Every attempt is written to auth.login_audit.
  • OTP: auth.issue_otp / auth.verify_otp store a hashed 6-digit code with expiry and single use (for the "email OTP" login path).
  • Sessions: idle expiry (30 min), auth.logout, auth.verify_session(token) returns account, person and roles.
  • Switch login: one person can have a student account and a staff account (auth.account.person_id is not unique).
  • Roles: auth.account_role grants a role optionally scoped to a department, hall or program (HoD of CSE, hall office of RK Hall).

6. Database roles and defence in depth

PostgreSQL roleUsed byRights
erp_ownermigrations onlyowns all objects (NOLOGIN)
erp_appthe ERP applicationDML on business tables, EXECUTE on the auth functions; no direct access to password hashes, tokens or OTPs
erp_roNatQuery, after SET LOCAL ROLESELECT only; no secret columns; row-level security applies
natquerythe login NatQuery connects withno table privileges at all; can only become erp_ro

Row-level security is enabled on 20 high-risk tables (students, persons, identities, bank accounts, guardians, registrations, results, performance, medical leave, counselling, fee demands, payments, income declarations, mediclaim, scholarships, salary slips, library loans and dues). NatQuery sends erp.role, erp.student_id, erp.person_id, erp.employee_id, erp.dept_id and erp.hall_id with every query; a request with no context sees no rows. Columns are limited by NatQuery only (the database role holds SELECT on the non-secret columns).

7. Synthetic data

Generated by seed.py with a fixed seed, so every build is identical: about 2,500 students (six admission years, B.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc., Ph.D.), 240 staff, 8 halls, 190 courses, 11 academic sessions with registrations, results, attendance and performance, fee demands and payments, 9,000 library loans, 1,500 paperless applications, placements, guest-house bookings and menus: roughly 368,000 rows. Deliberate traps are included: a student with the same name as a faculty member, duplicate names, ten people holding both a student and a staff login, graduates with expired roles and disabled accounts. Contact numbers start with 55 and e-mails use .example domains, so none can belong to a real person.
